errors.evidence: The x-axis does not use a linear scale; the spacing between tick marks is not uniform (e.g., the distance between 1e7 and 2e7 is different from the distance between 2e7 and 5e7).

errors.text_span: with tick labels displayed at intervals of 1e7
errors.evidence: The tick labels on the x-axis are not at regular intervals of 1e7. The values are 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, etc., which are non-uniform intervals.

errors.text_span: starting at approximately 97.8% at 1e7 TFLOPS and remaining steady at approximately 99.8% from 2e7 TFLOPS onwards
errors.evidence: The "Vanilla" line is constant at a Loss Ratio of 100% for the entire range of TFLOPS shown, not starting at 97.8% and leveling at 99.8%.
The line for "SepLLM (n=64)" has plus-sign (+) markers, not cross markers (x). Cross markers are used for the "SepLLM (n=128)" line.
The description of the "SepLLM (n=64)" line omits a key feature: it peaks above 100% at 4e8 TFLOPS before decreasing slightly.
The line for "SepLLM (n=64, H)" has diamond markers, not triangle markers. Triangle markers are used for the "Vanilla" line.
The final value for the "SepLLM (n=64, H)" line at 9e8 TFLOPS is approximately 99.8%, not 99.3%.
The description of the "SepLLM (n=64, H)" line omits that it peaks above 100% at 6e8 TFLOPS.
For the "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" line, the value at 2e7 TFLOPS is approximately 95.2%, not 98.5%.

errors.text_span: then varying between approximately 98.2% and 98.7% for the remainder of the x-axis values
errors.evidence: This description of the "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" line is inaccurate and an oversimplification. The line peaks at approximately 99.1% at 4e8 TFLOPS, a value outside the stated range, and shows more distinct variation than described.
